Fault scenarios as eval ground truth

nodes.label: System architecture (demo system -> platform API -> Kafka -> worker -> OpenSearch -> detector -> Postgres -> AI -> dashboard)
nodes.norm_label: system architecture (demo system -> platform api -> kafka -> worker -> opensearch -> detector -> postgres -> ai -> dashboard)

nodes.label: redpanda (Kafka-compatible broker)
nodes.rationale: Lighter than Kafka + ZooKeeper; sized for a laptop.

nodes.label: postgres (pgvector pg16, :5432)
nodes.rationale: pgvector extension for runbook and incident search; init.sql enables it on first start.

nodes.label: Dead-Letter Queue logs.dlq
nodes.rationale: Nothing silently dropped: invalid or rejected records go to DLQ with payload and reason.

nodes.label: Kafka Between Ingest and Indexing
nodes.rationale: 202 only after acks=all; keyed by service.name to keep per-service order; 6 partitions.

nodes.label: OTel Log Record Schema (Zod ingestion contract)
nodes.norm_label: otel log record schema (zod ingestion contract)

nodes.label: Client-Abort 499 Logging Fix
nodes.rationale: finish never fires for abandoned requests; requestLogger now listens for close and logs 499 with http.client_aborted.

nodes.label: Idempotency Enforced at Storage (_id = eventId)
nodes.rationale: Worker writes with create and _id=eventId; offsets committed after indexing; at-least-once delivery with exactly-once storage.

nodes.label: Logger Never Breaks a Service
nodes.rationale: Exporter catches every error, bounds its buffer, rate-limits its own warnings.

nodes.label: TypeScript Monorepo with npm Workspaces
nodes.rationale: Services share log schema and middleware so a log-format change is a type error everywhere; tsx runs TS directly with no build step.

nodes.label: Platform Logs to stdout Only
nodes.rationale: Sending its own logs through its own ingest would create a feedback loop.

nodes.label: Two Processes, One Codebase (API + worker)
nodes.rationale: API only validates and publishes to Kafka so ingestion stays fast when OpenSearch is slow; modular monolith plus one worker.

nodes.label: Incident Lifecycle (detected->investigating->identified->resolved)
nodes.rationale: Resolved is final; auto-resolve after 5 quiet minutes; rules are pure functions in incidents/lifecycle.ts.

nodes.label: Incident Grouping by Time (10-minute window)
nodes.rationale: Cascading failures across services become one incident; deploys from 30 min before are attached as context, not cause.

nodes.label: Metrics Computed From Logs
nodes.rationale: One OpenSearch aggregation per tick; no separate metrics store to keep in sync.

nodes.label: Stateless EWMA / z-score Detection
nodes.rationale: Every 15 s re-reads last 40 minutes; alpha 0.3, z>=3 plus minimum delta; anomalous points excluded from baseline; anomalies unique on service/metric/window.

nodes.label: Traces Used for Correlation, Not Exported
nodes.norm_label: traces used for correlation, not exported
nodes.rationale: Spans exist only to carry trace ID across services onto log records; platform rebuilds requests from logs.

nodes.label: POST /payments
nodes.rationale: Gateway call with 2 s timeout and 2 retries with exponential backoff on 5xx, timeouts and network errors.

nodes.label: Strict Mapping with Promoted Typed Fields + flat_object
nodes.norm_label: strict mapping with promoted typed fields + flat_object
nodes.rationale: Arbitrary attribute keys would conflict under dynamic mapping; typed copies for filters/aggregations, all attributes kept searchable.

nodes.label: Code Conventions (Zod validation, HttpError, callJson timeouts)
nodes.norm_label: code conventions (zod validation, httperror, calljson timeouts)

nodes.label: SimulatedDbPool (in-process DB pool)
nodes.rationale: Behaves like pg.Pool so the demo needs no database and pool exhaustion is real contention.

nodes.label: Week 5 Eval Harness (ground truth)
nodes.rationale: Inject fault, let the investigator run, compare top hypothesis to root cause; target 8 of 10 correct.

nodes.label: INC-1 Bad Deploy Detected in 74.5 s
nodes.norm_label: inc-1 bad deploy detected in 74.5 s

nodes.label: Evidence Verifier
nodes.rationale: Re-runs every cited query and keeps only supported claims.

nodes.label: Investigation Flow (Week 4, planned)
nodes.rationale: If the LLM call fails, a rule-based summary is stored instead.

nodes.label: AI Investigator
nodes.rationale: LLM finds probable root cause; every claim is backed by a log or metric query the backend re-runs to check.

nodes.label: Results Metrics (lag, time to detect, throughput, accuracy)
nodes.norm_label: results metrics (lag, time to detect, throughput, accuracy)

nodes.label: README: AI Log Analyzer & Incident Assistant
nodes.norm_label: readme: ai log analyzer & incident assistant

nodes.label: Keep Docs In Sync Rule
nodes.rationale: Owner requires every behaviour change to update API.md, CODEBASE.md, PROJECT_FLOW.md, FAULTS.md, PROGRESS.md, Postman script and the graphify graph in the same piece of work.

nodes.label: Fixed Tech Stack Rule
nodes.rationale: Stack fixed by the plan: TypeScript, Express, KafkaJS, OpenSearch, Postgres+Prisma+pgvector, Zod, Next.js with CSS Modules (no Tailwind), Vitest. Only must-have features until end-to-end demo works.

nodes.label: CommonJS not ESM
nodes.rationale: OpenTelemetry patches http/express by hooking require; works without loader flags in CommonJS.

nodes.label: Faults Invisible in Logs (stderr only)
nodes.rationale: Keeps AI evaluation honest: the investigator must reason from symptoms.

nodes.label: Faults Change Real Code Paths
nodes.rationale: Symptoms look like production failures with real stack traces.

nodes.label: Prisma 6, not 7
nodes.rationale: Prisma 7 requires driver adapters and a config file; 6.19 is stable and needs neither.

nodes.label: Tracing Is a Separate Entry Point
nodes.norm_label: tracing is a separate entry point
nodes.rationale: Main index imports Express; tracing must load first so Express is patched, hence each service index.ts imports ./instrumentation first.
